component_reference.title: Components
component_reference.intro: The shared parts of this theme, for checking them in a preview. This page is only reachable with ?view=components.
component_reference.rich_text_text: Pages, articles and product descriptions set merchant content like this, in a default, small and large size.
component_reference.rich_inline_html: Bold, italic, highlighted and removed text, an SKU, a note1, Esc and code.
component_reference.rich_nested: A list item can hold its own paragraphs and a nested list.
component_reference.rich_paragraph: Running text follows the size of its rich text block and reads slightly larger on phones.
component_reference.rich_opt_out: This part keeps the theme's own styles through data-not-typeset.
component_reference.heading: Heading {{ level }}
component_reference.lead: Lead text introduces a page or section.
component_reference.paragraph: Body text reads at 16 pixels with a relaxed line height.
component_reference.quote: A blockquote sets a quotation apart from the text around it.
component_reference.forms_text: Every control works without JavaScript through its native fallback, and submits its value with the form.
component_reference.reset_text: This clears the choices in the form above.
component_reference.item_text: Add a short description of this item.
component_reference.details_text: Add materials, dimensions or other details.
component_reference.more_text: Collapsible content stays visible without JavaScript.
component_reference.overlays_text: Popups open from a trigger that shows once its controller has started. Keep essential information on the page itself.
component_reference.popover_text: A popover holds short, nonessential content and links.
component_reference.hover_card_text: A hover card previews a link on hover or keyboard focus.
component_reference.drawer_text: Swipe down or press Escape to close.
component_reference.toast_text: A toast confirms an action and closes by itself.
